knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Fibrous material found in a wall cavity is treated as suspect until assessed. Disturbing work stops, occupants are kept clear, the area is sealed and a specialist assessment is obtained. Continuing because the fragments are small, sweeping, or using compressed air would spread the material.
Solvent waste and batteries are segregated and not put in general refuse.
Dry sweeping spreads fine dust into the air.
